SELECT count(*) as total_rows,
       count(model_name) as with_model,
       count(return_as_of_date) as with_returns,
       count(holding_count) as with_positions,
       count(distinct risk_profile) as risk_profiles,
       round(avg(ytd_return) * 100, 2) as avg_ytd_pct,
       round(avg(holding_count), 1) as avg_holdings,
       round(avg(total_unrealized_gain_loss), 2) as avg_unrealized_gl
FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_CANONICAL.CAN_PORTFOLIO
